_readme: Batch definition. Run with: python -m epicon run -m example_sweep
Keys prefixed with '_' are documentation and ignored by the loader.
model           REQUIRED. Test cases carry no model configuration.
temperature is pinned to 0.0 (REQ-RUN-009); do not set it.
thinking.enabled raises max_tokens to 2048 with a 1024 budget.
test_cases      Files, directories or globs relative to the project root.
execution.resume  Reconstruct turns 1..k from .journals/ and continue at k+1.
description: Example sweep over the abstract algebra cases.
